title: Reefer Cargo Services: special service charges at departure and how service fee rows are booked
content:
## Scope

This clause of **Reefer Cargo Services** covers the special service that some tiers include (cold treatment, controlled atmosphere, GDP handling or superfreezing) and the booking rules for the service fee rows of a reefer service: the special service charge, the remote monitoring fee, the late request fee and the cancellation fee.

## Rule

1. The tier's special service is charged **once, at departure**, at the tier's special service fee, under the tier's special service charge.
2. Tiers whose special service charge is "none" have no special service.
3. The late request fee and the cancellation fee are booked as rows of this same kind; when they arise and how much they are is decided by the rules on request lead time and on cancellation, not by this clause.
4. These service fee rows may be booked only while the service is **requested, in transit, delivered or cancelled**.
5. Each charge is booked **once per service**: a service never carries two rows under the same charge.

## Special service by tier

| Tier | Special service charge | Fee, charged once at departure |
|---|---|---|
| AHL Reefer Standard | None (no special service) | 0.00 USD |
| AHL Reefer Monitored | None (no special service) | 0.00 USD |
| AHL Reefer Cold Treatment | Cold treatment fee | 350.00 USD |
| AHL Reefer Controlled Atmosphere | Controlled atmosphere surcharge | 780.00 USD |
| AHL Reefer Pharma GDP | GDP handling fee | 550.00 USD |
| AHL Reefer Superfreezer | Superfreezer surcharge | 950.00 USD |

## Status check for booking a service fee row

| Service status | May a service fee row be booked? |
|---|---|
| Requested | Yes |
| PTI passed | No |
| Plugged in | No |
| In transit | Yes |
| Delivered | Yes |
| Closed | No |
| Cancelled | Yes |

## Hypothetical points of judgement

> A Controlled Atmosphere service departs and its controlled atmosphere surcharge of 780.00 USD is booked. Later the same surcharge is presented again for that service. The service already carries a row under that charge, so a second one is not booked.

> A Pharma GDP service is still plugged in at the load terminal. Its GDP handling fee is not booked yet: the fee is charged at departure, and no service fee row may be booked while the service is plugged in.

> A customer on AHL Reefer Monitored asks why no special service charge appears. The tier's special service charge is "none", so the tier has no special service.

## Basis Q&A

**Is the special service fee charged per day?** No. It is a single fee per service, charged once at departure.

**Does "once per service" stop a late request fee and a special service fee from both appearing?** No. They are different charges; the limit is one row per charge per service.
